records.question: Which product category generated the most revenue?

       SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue

GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 1;

records.question: What share of revenue comes from customers who ordered more than once?
records.raw:
WITH order_revenue AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, SUM(op.payment_value) AS revenue
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
  GROUP BY o.order_id, o.customer_id
),
repeat_customers AS (
  SELECT customer_id
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) > 1
)
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN rc.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN orv.revenue ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(orv.revenue), 0) AS share_repeat_customers
FROM order_revenue orv
LEFT JOIN repeat_customers rc ON orv.customer_id = rc.customer_id;

),

  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) > 1
)
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN rc.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN orv.revenue ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(orv.revenue), 0) AS share_repeat_customers

records.question: What was the month-on-month revenue growth rate through 2017?
records.raw:
WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
    SUM(op.payment_value) AS revenue
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-01-01'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  month,
  revenue,
  (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / NULLIF(LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0) AS growth_rate
FROM monthly_revenue
ORDER BY month;
records.sql:
WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
    SUM(op.payment_value) AS revenue
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-01-01'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  month,
  revenue,
  (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / NULLIF(LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0) AS growth_rate
FROM monthly_revenue
ORDER BY month;

records.question: What share of total revenue do the ten largest sellers account for?
records.raw:
WITH seller_revenue AS (
    SELECT seller_id, SUM(price) AS revenue
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY seller_id
),
total_revenue AS (
    SELECT SUM(revenue) AS total
    FROM seller_revenue
),
top10_revenue AS (
    SELECT SUM(revenue) AS top10
    FROM (
        SELECT revenue
        FROM seller_revenue
        ORDER BY revenue DESC
        LIMIT 10
    ) t
)
SELECT top10 / total AS share
FROM top10_revenue, total_revenue;
records.sql:

        ORDER BY revenue DESC
        LIMIT 10
    ) t
)
SELECT top10 / total AS share
FROM top10_revenue, total_revenue;

records.question: What is the average revenue per customer?

records.question: Which state has the highest average order value?
records.raw:
SELECT customer_state
FROM (
    SELECT c.customer_state, AVG(p.total_payment) AS avg_order_value
    FROM (
        SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS total_payment
        FROM order_payments
        GROUP BY order_id
    ) p
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_state
) t
ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC
LIMIT 1;

FROM (

        GROUP BY order_id
    ) p
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_state
) t
ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC
LIMIT 1;

records.question: In which month did the most customers place their first ever order?

  FROM orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
) t
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, month
LIMIT 1;

records.question: What was revenue in the last complete month of data?
records.raw:
WITH max_order_date AS (
  SELECT max(order_purchase_timestamp) AS max_ts
  FROM orders
),
last_complete_month AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE 
      WHEN date_trunc('day', max_ts) = last_day(max_ts) 
      THEN date_trunc('month', max_ts)
      ELSE date_trunc('month', max_ts) - interval '1 month'
    END AS month
  FROM max_order_date
)
SELECT sum(op.payment_value) AS revenue
FROM order_payments op
JOIN orders o ON op.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE date_trunc('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = (SELECT month FROM last_complete_month);

records.question: What share of 2018 revenue came from Sao Paulo state?
records.raw:

FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018;
